title: Map Mania
description:
Map Mania

title: Fun on the common (is back!)
description:
This is an efforts session … and is suitable for all abilities.
Whatever your pace is … that’s ok. 

We will start with a warm up routine followed by a series of ‘low hill repeats’. 
Then some cool down stretches. 

The session uses short loops with an incline. Efforts will be up the hill with flat and down being recovery. 

For those that have done this with me before it is on the figure of eight segment. 

Genuinely suits all abilities. 

For those wanting to try efforts for the first time or those coming back from injury (me included!) there is the option to sit out for a loop(s). 

Faster/stronger runners will be able to do more loops in the time. 

It’s fun … honest 😁

Martin 
[Phone Number Redacted]
location: Churchdown Road Malvern England WR14 United Kingdom
